checks.note: Integration tokens come from the projected workload token exchanged at the STS (identity.py:99-117), fetched at run time. AsyncAnthropic() takes its key from ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, which deployment.yaml never sets and no volume mounts. Its source is outside this repo, so a fixed key can be neither confirmed nor ruled out.

The projected workload token is bounded at 600s and STS tokens carry expires_in. The Slack signing secret and mail HMAC key are plain Kubernetes Secrets with no rotation or TTL in this repo, and no lifetime rationale is given beyond the README mention. Rotation may be handled outside the repo, so this cannot be decided.
Dockerfile ENVs, deployment env values and config hold no secret literals. Secrets are mounted from Kubernetes Secrets at run time, and CI runs a secret scan.

Tokens are sent as plain bearer headers (also payments.py:32 and slack.py:38) with no mTLS, DPoP or cert binding. Whether the internal STS, ERP gateway, payments API or Slack proxy support holder binding is not stated in the repo.

note: No check was shown to fail; the Anthropic key source, rotation of the mounted secrets and holder-binding support all depend on things outside the repo.
